audit.why: Aurora owns levels 1 through first item on range (900 Q vs 650 Null Sphere, 400 Force Pulse cone) and hands the last row to Kassadin at 2+ items when Riftwalk reaches 2s. The packet defect claiming 7/7 to Aurora is stale — phases[6] and win[6] already read Kassadin.
Spikes: 3-5 mana starvation, 6 Riftwalk-as-escape at 40 mana, first item as the widest gap, late as his full-build window. All four grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nether Blade's auto-attack reset is never named as the wind-up tell, and two bullets carry the trade lines verbatim under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Nether Blade is a 7s auto reset, so his commit shows in the attack wind-up, not in a cast bar; that is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid now names the Nether Blade tell; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's channel-interruptible flag on Null Sphere misfires.
audit.why: Riot's own text says Null Sphere interrupts channels — it is not itself a channel, so no line claiming Between Worlds cancels it was written.
audit.corrected: No edit made; flag contradicts the description and the description wins.

edits.before: Q from 900, E his step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — Null Sphere only reaches 650 and he ate it all.
edits.after: R's teleport edge lets you cross the zone while he pays 40 mana a Riftwalk to follow — fight where the slow holds him.

edits.before: Hopping IN with W to trade — his passive cuts your magic damage and Null Sphere shields the rest, so the exit spent as an entrance buys nothing.
edits.after: Null Sphere shields magic damage and Void Stone cuts the rest — at half HP the recast will not finish him, and the walk back costs you the hop.

edits.before: Post-6 Riftwalk is a 40-mana escape, not a threat. Keep shoving, keep him off CS, and take every objective he cannot contest.
edits.after: Post-6 Riftwalk is a 40-mana escape, not a threat; Nether Blade is a 7s auto reset, so his attack wind-up is the cue to step back.

notes: Packet defect 'chart gives Aurora 7/7' is stale — the 2+ items row already reads Kassadin in both layers, so no chart rows were moved. Packet suspectName 'The Weirding's' does not appear anywhere in the current text; also stale. Null Sphere's 'channel' flag is a tooltip-parse misfire: Riot's text says it interrupts channels, so nothing was written about cancelling it. Both lintFindings fixed.
